description: Rule data of the H-7 host scan (h7_scan.py; spec H-7, target/kernel DI-KS 15). H7a: last path segment of a banned include, either include form, case-insensitive. H7b: member-call names a host must not call on a product or capability module (spec H-7 (b); Rewind / Replay / Restore added by the architect 2026-11-13: on a non-kernel type they are rollback written outside the Kernel, target/kernel DI-KS 12). whitelist: the only types (fully qualified) whose listed methods a host may call; owners cannot extend it. unwrap: wrappers peeled off a declared type before the whitelist comparison (exact qualified names). Extend here, not in the script.

whitelist.note: the fixed-step accumulator, a clock tool of the runner (spec H-7, H.7 row 2)
the kernel's App (one World, its Registry, its schedules; kernel HANDOFF v8-arch-kernel-app-name, named by v8-arch-kernel-registry-schedule): Host calls its Run, Rewind, Replay, Restore (spec H-7)
